verdict.rationale: CAM's TMT sector page says the firm prides itself on its data privacy advice, which 'has always been ahead of the curve.' Its Co-Head of Digital/TMT authored analysis of India's newly notified DPDP Rules 2025, which shows privacy and data-protection counsel delivered through a documented digital/TMT practice. Missing for 10: a dedicated privacy/cybersecurity practice page, evidence of GDPR/CCPA or cross-border data-protection advice, cyber incident/breach counsel, and independent rankings or client corroboration of the privacy practice.
